title: The Germanized for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The Germanized for WooCommerce WordPress plugin up to version 4.1.8 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the billing_address.first_name parameter in the Store API checkout. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users access the injected page. The attack involves planting a payload through a guest checkout order's billing first name and triggering execution via an unauthenticated withdrawal request with a publicly available nonce.
